style: Avant-garde global art-rock fusion featuring precise 1/3-comma meantone quartal suspensions, highly ornamented santur tremolos, intricate zampoña hockets, and a continuous low refrigerator compressor drone. Harmony utilizes strict 1/3-comma meantone intervals alongside shifting modal drone fields. Melody combines fluidly ornamented nadaswaram runs, distinctive zampoña contours, and traditional Yoruba lexical tone pressure. Rhythm employs complex polyrhythmic 3:2 coupling, nested tuplets, physical stomp and clap floor grids, and crisp shekere pulses. Timbre features dry hammered santur, resonant udu clay, crisp darbouka, twanging berimbau, and piercing nadaswaram. Performance remains aggressively cheerful, deeply theatrical, and relentlessly hyper-kinetic throughout the entire piece. Core Anchor: an invariant 5-note melodic motif that safely survives multi-generation digital copy loss and severe signal dropouts in every pass.

caption: An aggressively cheerful, microtonal art-rock fusion exploring cosmic revelation through 1/3-comma meantone santurs, zampoña hockets, polyrhythmic 3:2 coupling, and Yoruba-Navajo vocal mouth mechanics. Broadcast via public-access television with multi-generation copy loss, digital disc skips, and radio telescope reception, the arrangement subjects the seed to recursive classification failure, clip-board administration, and split-crowd audience feedback.
